reviews.title: I have been a customer of Lebara for 3…
reviews.body: I have been a customer of Lebara for 3 years and have never had a problem, the reason I have given a poor score is the only time I have needed support,it has been sadly lacking, I made an enquiry a week ago the agent couldn’t resolve my issue so I raised a complaint, I had a call from Lebara next day which I answered but no one spoke , so the next day I contacted them again and was promised a call back, no one rang so I contacted them again and was promised a call back the following day,no one called so I contacted them and said I wanted a call back that day as I was playing golf the following day so I wouldn’t be able to answer the phone, so they rang in the middle of my golf round !! reviews.title: Over a Week Waiting for a SIM and No Resolution to My Complaint
reviews.body:
I have now spent more than a week trying to obtain a SIM card, with no confirmed delivery and no meaningful resolution.

The most frustrating part is the repeated assurances that have not been fulfilled, combined with the lack of communication and the apparent failure to follow through on the formal complaints process.

I understand that delivery delays can happen. However, I believe customers should receive accurate information, timely updates, and proper follow-up when something goes wrong.

Based on my experience, Lebara's customer service has been extremely disappointing. The handling of this straightforward issue has demonstrated very poor communication, a lack of accountability, and an apparent inability to resolve problems efficiently.

reviews.title: My experience with Libera Mobile has been remarkable.
reviews.body:
My experience with Libera Mobile has been generally positive. The service has been reliable for everyday calls, texts, and mobile data, and I have found the network coverage to be satisfactory in the areas where I regularly use it.

I also appreciate the straightforward pricing and the ease of managing my mobile service. Customer service has been helpful when I have needed assistance.

Overall, Libera Mobile provides a convenient and reasonably reliable mobile service, although there is always room for improvement in areas such as data speeds, coverage in some locations, and customer support response times.
